messages:
jo: Heads-up from our enterprise roundtable: several customers (NimbusHealth, LedgerAI) say per-route cost is a showstopper, but theyre also worried about retention/infra costs. We need to decide priority and whether a paid add-on for deep per-route analytics is acceptable.

sasha: Important to separate two asks: 1) accurate billing-facing numbers (needs heavy instrumentation), 2) fast troubleshooting surface (open-trace + coarse route estimation). Customers will accept a pragmatic hybrid: good-enough estimates in UI + detailed per-route as paid Dedicated feature.

mike_p: Agree. Suggested split:
- MVP: route-level estimates using sampled traces + model to apportion tokens when trace missing, CSV/export API, trace-link from error rows. Keep retention minimal (7d) for hosted.
- Add-on (paid): full per-route token accounting with 30d retention + route explorer + anomaly detection.

anita: Engineering tradeoffs: accurate per-route requires either (A) runtime accounting per request (adds overhead) or (B) statistical apportionment using sampled traces and request metadata. Option A gives <2% error but higher CPU; Option B is lower-cost infra with ~5% error if sampling tuned. We should quantify dev & infra costs.

mike_p: Rough estimates: 
- runtime request tagging + route token delta emit: 3.5 dev-weeks (higher perf risk)
- sampled trace approach + apportionment model + UI stitching: 2.0 dev-weeks + small model ops work
- CSV/export + trace-link plumbing: 1.0 dev-week
- infra indexing + feature flag + retention config: 1.0 infra-week
Total MVP (sampled approach): ~4 dev-weeks across squads. Accurate runtime approach ~7 dev-weeks and needs perf validation.

sasha: Proposal: ship sampled-estimation MVP for hosted (label numbers "estimated"), plus offer runtime-accurate per-route accounting as a Dedicated add-on for customers who need billing-grade numbers. This hedges infra cost and unlocks customers quickly.

jo: Launch gates we should require before canary:
- Accuracy: estimated route spend median error <=5% vs billing for top-20 routes over 7d (hosts) or <=2% for add-on customers (Dedicated).
- UX: trace-link opens correct trace <=2s for sampled traces >=95% of attempts.
- Perf: snapshot and route list p95 render <500ms under normal load.
- Reliability: CSV/API export success >=99% during canary.
- Privacy: audit signoff and clear "estimated" labeling + link to billing console.

anita: Tests: billing replay harness (synthetic workload) to validate the 5% gate for sampled estimator, e2e clicking trace-link and validating trace_url, a perf regression test for p95 render, and telemetry events route_estimate_view, csv_export, trace_link_click, paid_addon_upgrade.

cs-liz: From CS: customers will accept an "estimated" label + CSV interim, but several asked whether we can offer a time-limited trial of the paid add-on for pilots. Recommend offering trial for top pilots.

eng-bot: Created ticket RD-70001: "console: obs - sampled route estimates + trace-link + CSV (hosted MVP)" assigned to @mike_p, due 2026-05-12.

jo: Decision: ship sampled-estimation MVP for hosted with CSV and trace-link; surface a clear paid path for accurate per-route accounting in Dedicated. Action items:
- mike_p: break RD-70001 into subtasks + attach estimates (EOD)
- anita: draft acceptance test spec + perf validation plan (Tue)
- cs-liz: coordinate pilot trials and paid-add-on trial offers (Mon)
- sasha: write product copy with "estimated" labeling and billing links (Mon)
- infra: add feature flag redwood.obs_route_estimate_v1 + kill-switch (today)

mike_p: will split tasks and flag any perf concerns early.

sasha: Thanks  this keeps scope pragmatic but gives a path to billing-grade accuracy for customers who need it. Demo in next product sync. :rocket:
